title: Keith Dunstan: the man and his influence
question: These revisions put Keith first. Choose one, or reply in the agent chat with what to combine or change.

options.label: Keith, remembered
options.thesis: Lead with the man and an attributed recollection of his character.
options.viewport: A large portrait beside Keith’s name and a short tribute, followed by his public legacy.
options.risk: The tribute should invite discovery rather than feel like an obituary.

options.label: The man behind the column
options.thesis: An editorial profile introduces a modest man with a substantial public voice.
options.viewport: Keith’s name anchors a portrait-led profile, with career evidence in a narrow adjacent column.
options.risk: The evidence must support the personality without becoming a résumé.

options.label: A life that reached beyond the page
options.thesis: Connect the writer to his role in the life of Melbourne.
options.viewport: An intimate introduction above three biographical moments linking journalism, cycling and satire.
options.risk: Public activities must lead back to the writing.
